purpose: Wider isolated action cells preserve entire weapons

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production Soul of Meal isolated action sprite sheet. The reference is this character's existing 32-pose sprite atlas. Keep exactly the same face/species, costume/colors, physical weapons, chibi proportions and rendering quality. Generate ONLY EIGHT new complete physical action poses in FOUR columns by TWO rows on a landscape canvas aspect 2:1. Each cell is square and spacious. Each complete actor INCLUDING full weapon fits in the middle 65 percent of its own cell with a wide TRANSPARENT gutter on all sides. No touching neighboring poses. No clipped weapon. Consistent physical body scale, feet at same baseline. Row1: normal attack ready, windup, contact, recover. Row2: ultimate preparing, distinctive casting gesture, decisive impact, recover. All eight poses distinct. To make weapons fit, use strong DIAGONAL weapon poses, never a long horizontal weapon that extends into another cell. For a rooster, hold ONE halberd only, never duplicate it. Crab pincers stay physically attached to arms. Fox has one short three-pronged skewer and round woven shield. Golden firebird keeps its short leaf spear and fan-shaped physical wings. No magic glow, arcs, particle effects, trails, shadow or scene. These are clean actor cutouts to composite with a separate runtime effect. Absolutely no background, text, grid lines or labels.
